purpose: Canonical 1-day / 2-day / 3-day / 4+-day first-visit plans for Europe major cities and major scenic bases. This supplements regional packs and gives the UI one predictable duration selector.
rules: 1 day means a real usable sightseeing day, not a late-arrival day.
Each added day deepens the same city story; it must not simply append more famous names.
Relaxed mode normally uses one major morning anchor, one afternoon anchor, optional evening.
4+ does not mean the Grand Tour should automatically stay four nights; it is the deeper-city option when a user searches that duration.
Weather-sensitive scenic bases use extra days as weather flexibility before adding lower-value activities.

cities.name: Amsterdam
day_2_add: Anne Frank House with reserved slot
day_3_add: or Zaanse Schans if windmill-industrial theme
day_4_plus: Choose one deeper theme only: Dutch maritime history, modern art, or a quiet day trip; keep half-day unbooked

cities.name: Hamburg
day_4_plus: Use Hamburg as a slow port-city base; do not manufacture additional must-sees

cities.name: Copenhagen
day_4_plus: Choose a single specialist theme or nearby excursion; leave one half-day open

cities.name: Oslo
day_4_plus: fjord/nature excursion or full recovery day before western Norway

cities.name: Stockholm
day_4_plus: one specialist museum/archipelago day; preserve a low-load half-day

cities.name: Berlin
day_4_plus: Use extra day for one specialist museum or slower district exploration; history-heavy days should not all run back-to-back

cities.name: Warsaw
day_1: Łazienki or Uprising Museum — choose one
day_4_plus: No automatic fourth major museum; use a themed day or rest

cities.name: Kraków
day_3_add: Choose Auschwitz-Birkenau memorial OR deeper Kazimierz day, not both as rushed sightseeing
day_4_plus: If Auschwitz is included, use extra time for emotional breathing room and Kazimierz on a separate day

cities.name: Prague
day_3_add: repeat favorite river views at better light
day_4_plus: One specialist museum/day trip only if the city itself has already been experienced slowly

cities.name: Salzburg
day_3_add: one nearby landscape/theme excursion or full recovery before Dolomites
day_4_plus: Use as Alpine base only if itinerary theme calls for it; do not add urban checklists

cities.name: Val Gardena / Dolomites
day_1: Seceda if clear/operating; otherwise low-risk scenic alternative
day_2_add: Passo Gardena + Alpe di Siusi, paced as one scenic day
day_3_add: Lago di Braies early; remaining day light
day_4_plus: Tre Cime only with suitable access/weather
at least one weather-flex/recovery slot before adding anything else

cities.name: St. Moritz / Engadin
day_2_add: Muottas Muragl if clear or Val Fex if lower-cloud day
day_3_add: current-color larch pursuit or full slow valley day
day_4_plus: Extra days remain weather/photography flexibility, not compulsory attraction expansion

cities.name: Grindelwald / Interlaken
day_1: Jungfraujoch only if visibility justifies it; otherwise Lauterbrunnen
day_2_add: First OR Lauterbrunnen, whichever was not chosen
day_3_add: do not add a second expensive summit just to fill time
day_4_plus: weather retry or separate Zermatt extension only with a genuine additional travel day

cities.name: Chamonix
day_4_plus: Lac Blanc only with appropriate trail/season/weather; otherwise keep the day open

cities.name: Barcelona
day_2_add: Casa Batlló interior or another single Gaudí house
day_4_plus: one deeper art/architecture theme or neighbourhood day; do not add every Gaudí ticket

cities.name: Madrid
day_3_add: Reina Sofía if modern-art interest or slow market/neighbourhood day
day_4_plus: one day trip/theme only after a low-load Madrid half-day

cities.name: Porto
day_2_add: Douro Valley as a separate day OR a slow Porto day if driver wants rest
day_3_add: no requirement for a second distant excursion
day_4_plus: Use extra time for Douro pacing or recovery; separate tasting from self-driving

cities.name: Lisbon / Sintra
day_4_plus: Cabo da Roca/Cascais only if weather and energy support; otherwise preserve a free half-day

cities.name: Seville
day_4_plus: No need for more Seville checklists; use a themed excursion only if trip length allows

cities.name: Granada
day_3_add: one neighbourhood/hammam/history theme or full recovery
day_4_plus: Do not dilute Alhambra by adding distant attractions just to fill days

cities.name: Rome / Vatican City
day_4_plus: one deep theme per extra day: early Christian, archaeology, art, or neighbourhood life
at least half-day without a booking

cities.name: Florence / Tuscany
day_3_add: Chianti scenic drive as independent day
day_4_plus: one additional Tuscan town or slow Florence day; do not turn countryside into five-town race

cities.name: Venice
day_2_add: repeat canal experience at slower pace
day_3_add: Burano/lagoon island only if weather supports or a deeper art day
day_4_plus: Use extra day for lagoon/art/neighbourhood depth; no car-based day trips

cities.name: Dubrovnik
day_2_add: Lokrum only if seasonal boats operate
day_3_add: do not invent another major attraction
day_4_plus: Extra days should become coast/rest time, not more Old Town repetition

cities.name: Athens
day_3_add: Sounion only if clear or an Athens museum/rest day
day_4_plus: one additional archaeology/museum theme; preserve a free half-day

cities.name: Budapest
day_3_add: Great Market Hall or one specialist museum
day_4_plus: Use as recovery city on long road trip; do not convert every extra day into sightseeing

cities.name: Vienna
day_2_add: Hofburg or KHM as the main anchor
day_3_add: the major Day-2 anchor not chosen
day_4_plus: one specialist palace/museum/music theme per extra day; never three major palace/museum blocks in one day
